title: Migrate raw SQL to sqlx then add query with joins in Go — 3 turns
description: Raw database/sql migrated to sqlx for struct scanning, tests green, join query added.

files.go.mod:
module github.com/ai-verification/sqlx-migration

go 1.22

require (
    github.com/jmoiron/sqlx v1.3.5
    github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3 v1.14.22
)

task_spec.prompt: The test uses `db.DB` type (from sqlx) but the code uses `*sql.DB`. First, update `OpenDB` in `db/db.go` to return `*sqlx.DB` instead of `*sql.DB` (import `github.com/jmoiron/sqlx`). Update `GetAllUsers` to accept `*sqlx.DB` and use `sqlx.Select()` for struct scanning. Update the test's `setupTestDB` to return `*sqlx.DB`. Run `go test ./...`.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to confirm no regressions. Make sure sqlx.Select correctly populates User structs using the `db:` struct tags. Walk me through what changed.

Final pass: implement `GetPostsWithAuthor(*sqlx.DB)` using a JOIN query: `SELECT posts.id, posts.user_id, posts.title, users.name AS user_name FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.user_id = users.id`. Use `sqlx.Select()` to scan into `[]Post`. Then run `go test ./...` — all 2 tests must pass.
success_criteria: GetAllUsers uses sqlx.Select for struct scanning
GetPostsWithAuthor does JOIN and populates UserName field
